legal_rules_infrastructure.detail: Governed Ruleset/Rule/Source/TestCase/EngineRun schema and lifecycle (src-tauri/src/legal_rules.rs), a constrained-DSL rule interpreter (10 safe operators, no code eval/network/filesystem), and a Settings UI for authoring/testing/approving rulesets. Contains zero Israeli substantive law - a ruleset is only usable once a lawyer has sourced, tested and approved it. Phase B (Medical/Wage/Liability evidence ledgers) and Phase C (the first real lawyer-approved legal module) are deliberately not attempted.

legal_rules_infrastructure_hardening.detail: All 6 P0 findings and 5 of 6 P1 findings from the 2026-08-25 independent audit fixed and covered by new regression tests: terminal-state immutability (approved/superseded/revoked, not just approved), required non-empty reviewer identity on approve/review, page-level (not version-level) source grounding for approval, engine_kind always read from the ruleset itself, effective-period validation and enforcement, deterministic priority/rule_key tie-breaking, atomic single-transaction approval, forward-only engine-run status, exact integer arithmetic for cent-valued comparisons, and rejection of meaningless (assertion-free) test cases. P1-6 (linking legal_engine_runs to legal_deadlines/damage_calculations via FK) is deliberately deferred until real integration work begins, per the audit's own recommendation. cargo test --locked: 58/58 passing locally; this commit has not yet had its own Windows CI run - see docs/RELEASE_GATES.md for current status before treating it as CI-confirmed.
